issue: A pull whose payload passed full SHA-256 verification was marked FAILED when the separate SSH control connection closed before the finish cleanup acknowledgment; application and restart never ran.
changes: Treat only SSH disconnect/timeout during the final read-job finish as a nonfatal cleanup loss after complete content verification; bound the cleanup wait to 15 seconds and release the control session immediately.
Persist the authenticated pinned generation for offline recovery; verify the dataset binding, original manifest and every payload file before staging PENDING_APPLY.
Keep partial/corrupt downloads, changed targets, application journals, permission errors and upload failures fatal.
Label file transfer progress separately from application and health-checked completion.

realOpenSshRsync: Control process exits between rsync completion and local verification
Server disconnects after receiving finish without sending its acknowledgment
Self-inconsistent downloaded content is fatal and never reaches finish
Password, Unicode paths, bare-PATH SSH, dataset pinning and changed-host rejection remain effective
validation.actualSillyTavern: Isolated ST 1.19.0: legacy verified-download failure recovered offline, required confirmation, applied the original snapshot, restarted on the same port with a fresh nonce, and passed health checks without reconnecting.
validation.offlineDelivery: The exact inline repair command executed against a pristine pre-fix installed plugin fixture; integrity refusal and both UI copies verified; Bash syntax checked.

limits: The user Android device was not directly accessed or restarted.
